summary: Cross-browser/device matrix finished: 15/15 combos (chromium, firefox, webkit x 1366x768, 1920x1080, 768x1024, 390x844, 360x740) run with the corrected script /app/tests/load/ui_matrix2.py. Every combo got through landing, email screen, journey, Trial round, source underlines, glossary menu with options, Hindi transliteration suggestions (0.2-0.8s), Hindi text, Bold and submit with a score (20-25). No console or page errors (Cloudflare/CSP noise ignored). No horizontal scroll anywhere (the body uses overflow-x:clip). Fix 1: verified in headless Chromium. Fullscreen is really entered, keyboard.lock(['Escape']) is called and resolves, and Escape in the glossary menu and in the editor closes the menu or suggestions with no 'left the mission page' modal (left_page_count 0). Caveat: in headless Chromium, Escape did not exit fullscreen even after navigator.keyboard.unlock(), so headless cannot prove the lock is what stops the exit. That needs one manual check in headed Chrome. Fix 2 verified: 30 distinct texts returned 200 audio/wav, the 31st returned 429 {error:'tts_rate_limited'} in 0.09s, a cached repeat returned 200, and an anonymous call returned 401. The web client falls back to the browser voice on a non-200. Fix 3 passes code review. Final: /api/health 200 healthy and /api/health/db 200 connected. New findings: Esc in Firefox and Safari counts as leaving the page; the user menu is off-screen at 768-1023px; the enlist form overflows at 360px; mobile has no sign-in entry point; outside click sometimes fails to close the glossary menu.

minor.issue: Works as specified. Note: ttsQuota.clear() when size > 5000 resets every user's window (not a concern at about 100 players). The counter is incremented before the BHASHINI call, so failed TTS calls also use up the quota (acceptable).

ui_bugs.issue: keyboard.lock is Chromium-only. In Firefox, Escape (in the glossary menu or the editor) exits fullscreen and does NOT close the menu or suggestions. It shows the 'You left the mission page' modal and increments attempts.left_page_count. Verified: qa.xb09 attempt 2 has left_page_count=3 after 3 Esc presses; Chromium attempts stay 0. The editor placeholder tells everyone 'Esc = keep as typed', so Firefox/Safari officers will be counted as leaving, lose the cleanSheet badge, and see leaves on the report and manager views.

At 768-1023px the nav (hidden md:flex) plus logo, wordmark and coin bar push the user menu off-screen. The avatar button's right edge is at about 1003px on a 768 or 820 viewport in all engines. At 1024 the name chip is cut off. Tablet users cannot reach the profile or sign-out menu. Suggest nav 'hidden lg:flex' or hiding the wordmark/coin bar at md.

The card overflows the viewport by about 8-9px in all engines. The 'Enlist for the challenge' heading and the right edges of the inputs and the 'Listen' button are clipped (hidden by overflow-x:clip, so there is no scroll). Fine at 390px.

The landing 'Sign in' link is 'hidden sm:inline', and /register has no 'Already registered? Sign in' switch. A returning officer on a phone gets the full enlist form and must fill name, mobile, office and address just to sign in (verify then routes existing users correctly). Suggest a sign-in link on the mobile landing or the register form (/register?returning=1).

Intermittent: a mousedown on the editor reaches document but the menu stays open. Reproduced in 1 of 3 isolated WebKit tries and 4 of 10 matrix runs (Firefox and WebKit only). Likely root cause: the effect deps include onClose, an inline arrow from Round that is recreated on every render (the timer re-renders each second). Each re-render removes the mousedown listener and re-adds it in setTimeout(0), so a click in that gap is missed. Fix: useCallback for onClose/onPick or keep them in refs, and attach the listener once. A second click closes the menu.

design_issues.screen: Round on mobile (390/360) while suggestions are shown
issues: The fixed suggestion strip (z-90) covers the page footer (Page 1 of 1 / zoom); expected while suggesting. The last chip 'sarkar · keep as typed' is off-screen at 360/390 (the strip scrolls sideways).

action_items: Firefox/Safari: do not count Esc-driven fullscreen exits as leaving the page, or give an alternative to Esc (e.g. a 'keep as typed' click or another key) and show the 'Esc = keep as typed' hint only where navigator.keyboard.lock exists. Otherwise brief officers to use Chrome/Edge for tomorrow's session.
Header at 768-1023px: keep the user menu on screen (nav hidden below lg, or hide the wordmark/coin bar at md).
Add a 'Sign in' link for phones (landing below sm and/or on /register).
GlossMenu: memoize onClose/onPick (or use refs) so the outside-click listener is not removed on every timer re-render.
Manual check in headed Chrome: after Start Mission, press Esc in the editor; the app should stay fullscreen with no modal (headless cannot show this).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix 1 (PreRound.enterFullscreen): requestFullscreen, then navigator.keyboard?.lock?.(['Escape']).catch(); 'Back to the mission' calls enterFullscreen again, so the lock is renewed. Correct for Chromium. Firefox and Safari have no Keyboard Lock API, so Esc still exits there (see ui_bugs).

Fix 2 (services.ts /sahayika/tts): the per-email window {start,n} is mutated in place, limit >30 per 600s applies only on cache misses, cache hits skip the quota, and 401 is returned before the quota for anonymous callers. Correct.

Fix 3 (bhashini/client.ts callService): timedOut = lastErr.name === 'AbortError'; the breaker increment is skipped only for task==='transliteration' && timedOut, so other xlit failures and all tts/llm/asr/translation failures (timeouts included) still count. A caller abort (opts.signal.aborted) rethrows before the breaker. Node fetch throws DOMException AbortError on ctl.abort(), so the check is valid. Minor: `b` is read before the await loop and written back after, so concurrent calls can overwrite a breaker reset done by another request (a harmless race). Also, if BHASHINI xlit hangs completely, the breaker never opens and every word waits the full timeout before the per-word fallback (an accepted trade-off).

Each run uses one Trial chance per player (3 max); the script also accepts 'Resume'. Headless artefacts: Firefox has no is_mobile, and its fullscreen resizes to 1366x768 (mobile rows become desktop after Start Mission). WebKit is_mobile does not support Ctrl+A (use a DOM range plus tap). WebKit can take more than 1.5s to show the email field after Sign in. Headless Chromium never exits fullscreen on Esc. Screenshots are in /app/tests/load/shots2/.
rca of the issue: Esc in Firefox: the browser handles Esc before the page; without the Keyboard Lock API, fullscreen exits, the fullscreenchange handler in useFairPlay calls depart('left_fullscreen') and the server increments left_page_count. Header overflow: the nav becomes visible at md (768) but the header holds logo, wordmark, nav, coin bar and user chip, which need about 1000px. GlossMenu: the listener is torn down and re-added (setTimeout 0) on every parent render because the inline onClose is a dependency.
